This is the authoritative quest/level definition record (id, map, mode, difficulty, level, monster level, boss multipliers, status-ailment multipliers, reward/drop lists, level target). Client parses the shared config; server uses the same data authoritatively.

functions.purpose: Validates accepting an entrust (commission) quest. Resolves four config records by id: CMHLevelInfo(param_4=levelId), CLevelEnGroupInfo(param_2=groupId), CLevelEnSubGroupInfo(param_3=subGroupId), CLevelEntrustNpcInfo(param_5=npcId). Checks group prerequisite cost/item, group/subgroup unlock state, and level availability, returning granular error codes.
formulas: All four records must resolve non-null else return 0x2e631 (190001)
if group[iVar4+0x24] > 0: FUN_11399b20()->vtbl+0x10(group[+0x24]) must be true else return 0x2e63b (190011) — group entry cost/requirement check
unlock: (this[+4]+0x2b80)->vtbl+0x38(param_3) OR ->vtbl+0x44(subgroup+0x1c); if both false return 0x2e641 (190017)
(this[+4]+0x2b98)->vtbl+4(param_2) group must be unlocked else return 0x2e632 (190002)
(this[+4]+0x2b98)->vtbl+8(param_2,param_3) subgroup unlocked -> return 0 on success else 0x2e637 (190007)
costs: group[+0x24] is a prerequisite id/cost consumed via FUN_11399b20 manager (likely required item/currency for group entry)
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative validation: gates entrust/commission acceptance. Error codes 190001/190002/190007/190011/190017 must be replicated by the server for accept-entrust requests.
functions.notes: this+0x2b80 and this+0x2b98 are player-side subsystem managers (unlock tracking). CLevelEnGroupInfo/SubGroupInfo model the entrust group hierarchy.

functions.purpose: Claims the reward for a GuideBook chapter objective at index param_2. Validates the objective index, that it is not already claimed (bitmask), and that progress meets the requirement, then grants the reward item and sets the claimed bit.
formulas: if param_2 >= 0x20 or param_2 < 0 or (this[2] & (1<<param_2)) != 0 return 0x77a12 (489490) — already claimed / out of bit range
req = FUN_1180a860(param_2); if this[1] < *req return 0x77a16 (489494) — progress this[1] below required *req
if this[5] and manager (this[5]+0x2d1c): grant = mgr->vtbl+0x2c(req[1], 1, 0x85); item id=req[1], count=1, reason=0x85(133)
if grant != 0 return (grant==0x2a)+0x77a14 -> 0x77a14 (489492) or 0x77a15 on partial
costs: reward item id = req[1] (from FUN_1180a860), quantity 1, grant reason 0x85 (133)
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative: server grants the chapter-objective reward, tracks the per-objective claimed bitmask (this[2]) and the progress counter (this[1]) against required *req. Error codes 489489-489494.
functions.notes: this[1]=current progress, this[2]=claimed bitmask (up to 32 objectives), this[5]=owning player/inventory. FUN_1180a860 returns objective descriptor {requiredCount at [0], rewardItemId at [1]}.

functions.purpose: Returns 1 if any GuideBook chapter objective is currently claimable: enabled flag set, not yet claimed (bitmask), and progress meets the objective requirement.
formulas: claimable if: byte[this+0xd] != 0 AND i<0x20 AND (this[2] & (1<<i))==0 AND FUN_1180a860(i)[0] <= this[1]
functions.serverRelevance: validation/query: mirrors ClaimObjectiveReward's gating; used to light up the UI 'claim' button. Same progress(this[1]) vs required and claimed-bitmask(this[2]) semantics.
functions.notes: byte[this+0xd] gates whether claiming is enabled at all for this chapter.

On a specific code it grants an activity reward; otherwise formats an error log line.

each entry copied as 0x65 (101) dwords + 1 short (=406 bytes) into local buffer then appended to vector at (iVar2+0x2b9c)[+0x1c..+0x20], node size 0x10
else: format 'Recv Entrust Level List Fail Errcode = %d'
